morbi.headline: Morbi ceramic sector sees gas price relief amid export volatility and cost shocks.
what_changed: Morbi ceramic industry received a Rs 5 discount on natural gas prices dropping from Rs 82 following representations.
Ceramic shipments from Morbi to the Gulf have resumed despite a generally weak export outlook.
Kajaria Ceramics acquired a 19.77% stake in Sunsure Solar Park Twenty One for ₹1.21 crore and posted a Q2 2026 sales and profit beat.
stress_signals: Overall export outlook remains weak for the cluster with reports citing an alleged 50% decline in exports [c2b4a2f5422a, c2e1d2a72338].
A large suspicious stock of imported coal was discovered inside a closed ceramic factory in Rafaleshwar GIDC [f675c060fa53].
improvement_signals: Natural gas prices received a Rs 5 discount following industry representations [279312659941].
Kajaria Ceramics reported a Q2 2026 sales and profit beat [83abd2d67eca] and invested in solar energy [a2787358932e].
what_to_watch: Monitor sustainability of the Rs 5 natural gas discount and final pricing structures.
Track actual recovery and shipment volumes of ceramic exports to Gulf destinations.
Observe account-level liquidity, inventory levels, and repayment track records for units in Rafaleshwar GIDC.

surat.headline: Mixed signals for Surat as Diwali demand meets export slumps, unrest, and cost pressures.
what_changed: Textile units face rising operational costs from electricity hikes and power cuts alongside risk of labor agitations.
Diamond cluster shows conflicting signals with pre-Diwali demand contrasting against US export slumps and raw material shortages.
Textile market associations successfully recovered ₹6 crore in stuck mercantile payments across major markets.
stress_signals: Threat of fresh unrest and labor disruptions in man-made fabric manufacturing units following August agitations [d1fffb80f879].
Textile mills hit by unquantified power cuts and electricity tariff hikes affecting operating margins [385f9b90ae46].
US demand slump causing factory closures and order slowdowns for apparel and diamond exporters [caa34a6cf84e].
Diamond Worker Union submitted memorandum demanding unpaid pre-Diwali bonuses and overtime payments [c8a89bd2019b].
improvement_signals: Surat textile market traders recovered ₹6 crore in stuck payments for 70 traders across Global, Bombay, and Ring Road markets [a523a4bf860d].
Pre-Diwali festive boom and global demand driving short-term resurgence in Surat diamond industry [01cb30b63e0d].
Launch of ICA GemLab in Surat providing international-grade testing facilities for diamonds and jewelry [4b0e420193b2].
what_to_watch: Labor relations and potential strike notices across MMF textile manufacturing units to anticipate dispatch delays.
Pre-Diwali bonus payment compliance and working capital headroom among small-scale diamond cutting and polishing units.
Impact of electricity cost hikes on powerloom and processing unit margins during upcoming quarterly cash-flow audits.
